title: SymbolicSystem: connector and joint Jacobians by the one-pass derivative of one expression per item in the variables of its nodes
author: Claude-JG
description: Maintainer 2026-10-29: build the generalized forces of a connector, and the constraint equations and reaction forces of a joint, as one expression in the variables of its nodes (q, q_t of each node), and take their Jacobian by one EvaluateJacobian pass, instead of the chain rule composed by hand in _ConnectorJacobian and _JointJacobian (the derivative by the marker states times the marker Jacobians, plus the terms of marker Jacobians depending on q). The variables per node, so the cost grows with the item, not with the system; the columns scattered by ltg. Also the other coordinates an item can depend on: ODE1 coordinates (ObjectConnectorHydraulicActuatorSimple: forces by the pressures y, its ODE1 RHS by q and q_t), the algebraic coordinates z of a joint (c_i = z_i on free axes and for an inactive joint, C_q^T z and its derivative by q), and data coordinates (#3158). Small numerical differences to the composed Jacobian and to the C++ items are accepted; the present code kept as the comparison, accuracy and time measured, then decided which stays.
